**Job Description**
 AI Engineer
   

  

 Overview: As an AI Business Engineer, your role will be that of a business embedded technologist responsible for identifying, designing, and delivering AI enabled solutions directly within the line of business with a dotted line relationship to the centralized AI team for governance and scalability. In this role, you will have an excellent opportunity to work closely with business users in a collaborative environment, while executing \& assisting with the design and development of business\-driven projects
   

  

 The AI Business Engineer is a thinker and a hands\-on innovator. The ideal candidate is a passionate advocate for AI, someone who thrives on building AI driven workflows and someone whose passion is uncovering hidden inefficiencies and unlocking new levels of productivity through intelligent automation
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and build business driven workflow projects using Copilot based intelligent agents, low code/ no code automations, and AI assisted workflows using Microsoft Power Platform, Copilot Studio, and Microsoft 365 Chat
* Conduct research and gather data to support project planning and execution.
* Prepare technical documentation, reports and presentations as well as support the testing and validation of unit code, in conjunction with error handling through pipelines.
* Identify untapped opportunities and build for AI\-driven transformation within line of business processes
* Build solutions primarily using Copilot Studio, M365 Copilot, Azure services and platforms with a focus on Generative AI.
* Drive discovery sprints and AI ideation efforts
* Stay abreast of broad AI efforts and initiatives by collaborating with our bank\-wide AI department


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information\-technology, engineering, system analysis, Artificial Intelligence \& Robotics or a related study, or equivalent experience.
* Strong knowledge of general Financial Services \& Technology is preferred.
* Working knowledge of M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, knowledge of cloud platforms and rapid prototyping tools
* Strong understanding \& working knowledge of Agentic AI including LLMs, Agents, prompts and other protocols
* Strong understanding of process consulting, process engineering, operations modernization, or business transformation in financial services
* Understanding of automated code build solutions for CI/CD Pipelines.
* Full stack development
* Strong interpersonal \& problem\-solving skills along with the ability to build relationships with team members, stakeholders, and external partners.


 Tech Stack: Full stack developer, Strong azure \& cloud knowledge and Built applications using AI
   

  

 Salary Range\- $110,000\-$125,000 a year
